'$'''eval '''
 echo "Outer eval"
 (
 echo "Inner eval subshell"
 ( echo "Deeper eval bg" & )
 )
 '''' (90 us, 0.04%)

'$'''cat <<'''EOF''' > /tmp/dynamic.sh
#!/bin/bash
echo "Sourced dynamic script"
( ( echo "Nested in sourced" & ) )
declare -a local_arr=(a b c)
for val in "${local_arr[@]}", do
 echo "Sourced loop: $val"
done
EOF
' (1,275 us, 0.51%)
'@TRAP (USR1): echo "USR1 trap"\, ( ( echo "Nested in USR1" & ) )' (6,405 us, 2.55%)
'select opt in a b quit' (198 us, 0.08%)
'trap '\''echo "EXIT trap triggered", ( ( sleep 1 & ) & wait )'\'' EXIT' (21,533 us, 8.59%)
'trap '\''echo "USR1 trap", ( ( echo "Nested in USR1" & ) )'\'' USR1' (20,767 us, 8.28%)
